# Third-party runtime components

- [`mujoco-warp/`](mujoco-warp/) contains the installable patched MuJoCo-Warp
  distribution, upstream file manifest, active-world patch, LICENSE and AUTHORS.
- OGBench is installed from its public Python package. Its retained MIT notice
  is [`ogbench-LICENSE.txt`](../docs/provenance/ogbench-LICENSE.txt).

CASTLE's selected engine integration and controller are maintained under
[`src/castle_reasoning/runtime/`](../src/castle_reasoning/runtime/).
Source identities and reproduction instructions are in
[provenance](../docs/provenance.md).
